recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.author: test@test.com
recipes.description: Classic Italian pasta with eggs, pecorino cheese, black pepper and crispy bacon.
recipes.steps: Cook the pasta. Fry the bacon. Mix eggs and cheese. Combine everything while pasta is hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Soup
recipes.author: test@test.com
recipes.steps: Boil chicken in water or broth. Add chopped vegetables and cook until soft. Season with salt, pepper and parsley.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
recipes.author: test@test.com
recipes.steps: Mix the dry ingredients for the cake. Add eggs, melted butter and milk. Bake at 180°C for 35 minutes. For the ganache: heat the cream until just boiling, pour over chopped chocolate, add butter and mix until smooth. Spread the ganache over the cooled cake.

recipes.title: Fresh Garden Salad
recipes.author: test@test.com
recipes.description: Fresh vegetables with olive oil and lemon juice.
recipes.steps: Cut all vegetables, mix in a bowl and season with olive oil, salt and lemon juice.

recipes.title: Margherita Pizza
recipes.author: hi@test.com
recipes.description: Italian pizza with tomato sauce, mozzarella and basil.
recipes.steps: Spread tomato sauce on dough, add mozzarella, bake at 220°C for 12 minutes. Finish with basil and olive oil.

recipes.title: Beef Burger
recipes.author: test@test.com
recipes.description: Juicy beef burger with lettuce, tomato and crispy fries.
recipes.steps: Shape beef patty, season and cook in a pan. Build the burger with vegetables and cheese in the bun.

recipes.title: Pancakes
recipes.author: hi@test.com
recipes.description: Fluffy pancakes served with maple syrup and berries.
recipes.steps: Mix all ingredients and fry small portions of batter in butter until golden on both sides.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.author: test@test.com
recipes.description: Creamy Italian risotto with mushrooms and parmesan.
recipes.steps: Cook onion and mushrooms in butter. Add rice and slowly pour broth while stirring until creamy. Add parmesan.

recipes.title: Chicken Tacos
recipes.author: hi@test.com
recipes.description: Soft tortillas filled with spicy chicken, vegetables and cheese.
recipes.steps: Cook chicken with taco seasoning. Fill tortillas with chicken, vegetables and cheese.

recipes.title: Lasagna
recipes.author: hi@test.com
recipes.description: Layered lasagna with beef, ricotta, mozzarella and tomato sauce.
recipes.steps: Layer lasagna sheets with meat sauce and cheeses. Bake at 190°C for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Fry Fish
recipes.author: test@test.com
recipes.steps: Clean the fish, cut into portions. Season with salt and pepper and spices to your taste. Heat the oil. Fry the fish and serve. Bon appetit.
